legend: Valentine's day is coming soon!! It is a special day not only for humans, but also for the dinosaurs living in Dinoland!

Danny, being a popular dinosaur, got asked out by many other Dinosaurs. Indeed, he received K$$$K$$$ date invitations numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to K$$$K$$$. The ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ date invitation was sent to him by Dinosaur i$$$i$$$.

However, there is a little problem. Danny has a group of N$$$N$$$ friends, that can be modelled as a tree where each node represents one of Danny's friends. Two dinosaurs are called direct friends if there is an edge between them. Two dinosaurs are friends if there is a path between them, and we say that they belong to the same friend group. Each of Danny's friends is numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to N$$$N$$$, and the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ of them has a value ai$$$a_i$$$ that represents their dating history.

If Danny accepts the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ date invitation for Saint Valentine, all of his friends who have dated the dinosaur who sent that invitation will get mad and leave the friend group. A friend j$$$j$$$ will get mad when Danny accepts the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ date invitation if and only if i$$$i$$$ divides aj$$$a_j$$$. When a dinosaur leaves the friend group, he will not be part of the group anymore and his ties with his direct friends will disappear. As a result, the group will be fragmented, and turn into multiple smaller friend groups.

Danny is weighing the pros and cons of accepting the invitations he got. He asked for your help. He wants you to tell him, for each invitation i$$$i$$$ that he got, how many friend groups he will end up with.
input: On the first line of input you are given two integers N$$$N$$$ and K$$$K$$$ (1≤N,K≤106)$$$(1 \leq N, K \leq 10^6)$$$
On the second line of input, you are given N$$$N$$$ integers a1a2...aN$$$a_1a_2 ...a_N$$$ (1≤ai≤106)$$$( 1 \leq a_i \leq 10^6)$$$

On each of the next N−1$$$N-1$$$ lines of input, you will be given two integers u$$$u$$$ and v$$$v$$$ (1≤u,v≤N$$$1 \leq u, v\leq N$$$) denoting that friends u$$$u$$$ and v$$$v$$$ are direct friends and that there is an edge between them. It is guaranteed that the friends form a tree.
output: Print K$$$K$$$ integers, the number of remaining friend groups if Danny excepts each invitation.
note: The friends' tree looks initially like this:
Accepting invitation 1$$$1$$$ will lead to Danny losing all his friends, and as a result, the number of friend groups remaining will be 0$$$0$$$

Accepting invitation 2$$$2$$$ will lead to Danny losing friends 3$$$3$$$ and 4$$$4$$$ which leads to two separate remaining friend groups. ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c91c71485513cdd7a0a72751cdc34765c12fec0.png)
Accepting invitation 3$$$3$$$ will lead to Danny losing friends 2$$$2$$$ and 4$$$4$$$ which leads to one remaining friend group.

legend.ai: 情人节就要到了！！这不仅是人类的特殊节日，也是生活在 Dinoland 的恐龙们的特殊节日！
Danny 是一只很受欢迎的恐龙，许多其他恐龙都邀请他约会。事实上，他收到了 K$$$K$$$ 个编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 K$$$K$$$ 的约会邀请。第 i$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ 个约会邀请是由恐龙 i$$$i$$$ 发给他的。

不过，这里有一个小问题。Danny 有 N$$$N$$$ 个朋友，可以用一棵树来表示，其中每个节点代表 Danny 的一位朋友。如果两只恐龙之间存在一条边，则称它们是直接朋友。如果两只恐龙之间存在一条路径，则称它们是朋友，并称它们属于同一个朋友圈。Danny 的每位朋友编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 N$$$N$$$，其中第 i$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ 位朋友的值为 ai$$$a_i$$$，表示其约会经历。

如果 Danny 接受了第 i$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ 个圣瓦伦丁约会邀请，所有曾与发出该邀请的恐龙约会过的朋友都会生气并离开朋友圈。当且仅当 i$$$i$$$ 能整除 aj$$$a_j$$$ 时，朋友 j$$$j$$$ 会在 Danny 接受第 i$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ 个约会邀请时生气。当一只恐龙离开朋友圈后，它将不再属于该朋友圈，并且它与直接朋友之间的联系也会消失。因此，朋友圈会被分割成多个更小的朋友圈。
Danny 正在权衡接受这些邀请的利弊。他请求你的帮助。对于他收到的每个邀请 i$$$i$$$，他想让你告诉他，最终会有多少个朋友圈。

input.ai: 输入的第一行给出两个整数 N$$$N$$$ 和 K$$$K$$$(1≤N,K≤106)$$$(1 \leq N, K \leq 10^6)$$$。
在接下来的 N−1$$$N-1$$$ 行输入中，每行给出两个整数 u$$$u$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$(1≤u,v≤N$$$1 \leq u, v\leq N$$$)，表示好友 u$$$u$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$ 是直接好友，且它们之间存在一条边。保证这些好友构成一棵树。

output.ai: 输出 K$$$K$$$ 个整数，分别表示 Danny 接受每个邀请后剩余的好友组数量。

note.ai: 好友构成的树最初如下所示：
接受邀请 1$$$1$$$ 将导致 Danny 失去所有朋友，因此剩余的朋友圈数量将为 0$$$0$$$
接受邀请 2$$$2$$$ 将导致 Danny 失去朋友 3$$$3$$$ 和 4$$$4$$$，从而形成两个彼此分离的剩余朋友圈。![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c91c71485513cdd7a0a72751cdc34765c12fec0.png)
接受邀请 3$$$3$$$ 将导致 Danny 失去朋友 2$$$2$$$ 和 4$$$4$$$，从而剩下一个朋友圈。
